name: PowOS phone ADB transport
purpose: Existing powos-vadb container runs the shared ADB server in wireguard's network namespace. Ship and verify tools depend on it. Restart policy: unless-stopped; after Docker recovery, confirm wireguard is running and adb get-state reports device.
installedBy: Existing android-app-dev builder container; recovery: docker update --restart unless-stopped powos-vadb && docker start powos-vadb
unbounded: Existing shared transport; no new resource limits imposed during recovery
